title.zh: 卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一
title.en: Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1
title.raw: 卷八十一 晉書7: 少帝本紀一 Volume 81 Book of Later Jin 7: Emperor Shao 1

sentences.zh: 少帝，名重貴，高祖之從子也。

translations.literal: The Young Emperor, named Chonggui, was Gaozu's younger cousin-son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shao, whose personal name was Chonggui, was Gaozu's nephew.

sentences.zh: 考諱敬儒，母安氏，以唐天祐十一年六月二十七日生帝於太原汾陽裏。

translations.literal: His father's taboo name was Jingru; his mother was the An clan. On the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month in the eleventh year of Tianyou of Tang, the Emperor was born in Fenyang Lane, Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father bore the taboo name Jingru and his mother was of the An clan. He was born on the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month of the eleventh year of Tang Tianyou (914) in Fenyang Lane, Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 敬儒嘗為後唐莊宗騎將，早薨，高祖以帝為子。

translations.literal: Jingru had once been a mounted general under Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong; he died young, and Gaozu took the Emperor as his son.
translations.idiomatic: Jingru had served as a cavalry general under Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong. After he died young, Gaozu adopted the future emperor as his own son.

sentences.zh: 帝少而謹厚，高祖愛之。

translations.literal: The Emperor was prudent and steady in youth, and Gaozu loved him.
translations.idiomatic: As a youth he was careful and steady in character, and Gaozu doted on him.

sentences.zh: 洎歷方鎮，嘗遣從行，委以庶事，但性好馳射，有祖禰之風。

translations.literal: When he later held regional commands, he was often sent to accompany Gaozu on his travels and entrusted with routine affairs, yet his nature favored galloping and archery, showing the manner of his forefathers.
translations.idiomatic: Once he began serving in the provinces, Gaozu often had him travel in attendance and entrusted him with day-to-day business, though he naturally loved riding and archery and bore something of his ancestors' martial spirit.

sentences.zh: 高祖鎮太原，命瑯琊王震以《禮記》教帝，不能領其大義，謂震曰：「非我家事業也。

translations.literal: When Gaozu held Taiyuan, he ordered Prince Langya Wang Zhen to teach the Emperor the Book of Rites, but the Emperor could not grasp its larger meaning and told Zhen, "That is not the enterprise of our house.
translations.idiomatic: While Gaozu was stationed at Taiyuan, he had Prince Langya Wang Zhen instruct the future emperor in the Book of Rites, but the prince could not grasp its larger meaning and told Zhen, "That is not the calling of our house.

sentences.zh: 」及高祖受圍於太原，親冒矢石，數獻可於左右，高祖愈重焉。

translations.literal: " When Gaozu was besieged at Taiyuan, the Emperor personally braved arrows and stones, repeatedly offering sound advice at Gaozu's side, and Gaozu valued him all the more.
translations.idiomatic: " When Gaozu was besieged at Taiyuan, the prince personally braved arrow and stone fire, repeatedly offering sound counsel at his side, and Gaozu came to esteem him all the more.

sentences.zh: 高祖受契丹冊，將入洛，欲留一子撫晉陽，先謀於戎王，戎王曰：「使諸子盡出，吾當擇之。

translations.literal: When Gaozu received investiture from the Khitan and was about to enter Luoyang, he wished to leave one son to oversee Jinyang and first consulted Prince Rong. Prince Rong said, "Have all the sons come forth; I shall choose among them.
translations.idiomatic: After Gaozu received Khitan investiture and was preparing to enter Luoyang, he wished to leave one son behind to oversee Jinyang and first sought Prince Rong's counsel. Prince Rong said, "Bring all your sons out; I shall choose among them.

sentences.zh: 」乃於行中指帝謂高祖曰：「此眼大者可矣。

translations.literal: " Then, on the road, he pointed at the Emperor and said to Gaozu, "This one with the large eyes will do.
translations.idiomatic: " Then, as they traveled, he pointed at the future emperor and told Gaozu, "This one with the large eyes will do.

sentences.zh: 」遂以帝為北京留守，授金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒，行太原尹，知河東管內節度觀察事。

translations.literal: " Thereupon the Emperor was made Northern Capital regent, appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and acting Minister of Education, acting Taiyuan prefect, and charged with the military governorship and surveillance of Hedong within the circuit.
translations.idiomatic: " He was accordingly made regent of the Northern Capital, appointed Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon and acting Minister of Education, acting prefect of Taiyuan, and given charge of the Hedong circuit's military governorship and surveillance.

sentences.zh: 天福二年九月，征赴闕，授光祿大夫、檢校太保、右金吾衛上將軍。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the second year of Tianfu, he was summoned to court and appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Grand Mentor, and General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Guard.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tianfu 2 (937), he was summoned to court and appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness, acting Grand Mentor, and General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Guard.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，授開封尹，加檢校太傅，封鄭王，增食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year, he was made Prefect of Kaifeng, given the additional title of acting Grand Tutor, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted an additional three thousand households in his fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year three, he was appointed prefect of Kaifeng, given the additional title of acting Grand Tutor, enfeoffed as Prince of Zheng, and granted three thousand additional fief households.

sentences.zh: 俄加檢校太尉、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter he was given the additional titles of acting Grand Commandant and Co-Manager of Affairs under the Secretariat-Chancellery.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he was also made acting Grand Commandant and Co-Manager of Affairs under the Secretariat-Chancellery.

sentences.zh: 六年，高祖幸鄴，改廣晉尹，進封齊王。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, when Gaozu visited Ye, he was made Prefect of Guangjin and advanced in rank to Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, when Gaozu visited Ye, he was made prefect of Guangjin and promoted to Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: （以下疑脫「七年正月，加兼侍中」八字。）〉

translations.literal: (The following eight characters are suspected to be missing: "In the first month of the seventh year, he was additionally made Concurrent Palace Attendant.") )
translations.idiomatic: (The following eight characters are suspected to be missing here: "In the first month of the seventh year, he was additionally made concurrent Palace Attendant.") )

sentences.zh: 是歲六月十三日乙丑，高祖崩，承遺制命柩前即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month of that year, the day yichou, Gaozu died, and by the testamentary order he assumed the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the thirteenth day of the sixth month of that year, the day yichou, Gaozu died, and by testamentary decree he assumed the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 帝在并州未著人望，及保釐浚郊，大有寬裕之稱。

translations.literal: While the Emperor was at Bingzhou he had not yet won men's esteem, but once he secured the realm, dredged the suburbs, and governed, he won great repute for magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: While he was at Bingzhou he had not yet won wide esteem, but once he secured the realm, improved the capital outskirts, and took up rule, he gained a strong reputation for magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 從幸鄴都，是歲遇旱，高祖遣祈雨於白龍潭，有白龍見於潭心，是夜澍雨尺餘，人皆異之，至是果登大位焉。

translations.literal: Accompanying Gaozu on a visit to the capital at Ye, that year there was drought; Gaozu sent men to pray for rain at White Dragon Pool, a white dragon appeared in the center of the pool, and that night a soaking rain of more than a foot fell. All regarded it as extraordinary, and when he indeed ascended the supreme position, it seemed fulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: On a visit with Gaozu to the Ye capital that year there was drought; Gaozu sent men to pray for rain at White Dragon Pool, a white dragon appeared at the pool's center, and that night more than a foot of soaking rain fell. Everyone took it as a marvel, and when he did in fact ascend the throne it seemed a sign fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，賜侍衛諸軍將校錢一百貫下至五貫，以初即位示賫也。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the commanders and officers of the various guard armies were granted money ranging from one hundred strings down to five strings, as a display of bounty on his first accession.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, commanders and officers of the guard armies were granted cash gifts ranging from one hundred strings down to five, a bounty to mark his first accession.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，宰臣馮道等率百僚請聽政，凡三上表，允之。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the chief ministers led by Feng Dao and the hundred officials requested that he assume governance; they submitted memorials three times, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, chief ministers led by Feng Dao and the full bureaucracy petitioned him three times to assume governance, and he assented.

sentences.zh: 庚午，始聽政於崇德殿門偏廊，分命廷臣以嗣位奏告天地宗廟社稷。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, he first held court in the side corridor of the Gate of Chongde Hall and separately ordered court officials to report his succession to Heaven and Earth, the imperial temples, and the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu he held his first audience in the side corridor of Chongde Hall's gate and separately ordered court officials to report his succession to Heaven and Earth, the imperial temples, and the altars of soil and grain.

sentences.zh: 遣右驍衛將軍石德超等押先皇御馬二匹，往相州西山撲祭，用北俗禮也。

translations.literal: He dispatched Right Valiant Cavalry General Shi Dechao and others to escort two of the late emperor's imperial horses to the western hills of Xiangzhou for the pou sacrifice, using northern custom.
translations.idiomatic: He dispatched Right Valiant Cavalry General Shi Dechao and others to escort two of the late emperor's imperial horses to the western hills of Xiangzhou for the pou sacrifice, following northern custom.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以司徒、兼侍中馮道為大行皇帝山陵使，門下侍郎竇貞固副之，太常卿崔棁為禮儀使，戶部侍郎呂琦為鹵簿使，御史中丞王易簡為儀仗使。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Minister of Education and Concurrent Palace Attendant Feng Dao was made commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum, Vice Director of the Chancellery Dou Zhengu served as his deputy, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Rong was made ritual commissioner, Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made commissioner for the imperial train, and Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made commissioner for ceremonial regalia.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, Minister of Education and concurrent Palace Attendant Feng Dao was appointed commissioner for the late emperor's mausoleum, with Vice Director of the Chancellery Dou Zhengu as deputy; Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Rong was made ritual commissioner; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi, commissioner for the imperial train; and Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian, commissioner for ceremonial regalia.

sentences.zh: （徐無黨《五代史記註》云：舊史實錄無橋道頓遞使，疑不置或闕書，漢高祖亦然。）〉

translations.literal: (Xu Wudang's Commentary on the New History of the Five Dynasties states: The veritable records of the Old History contain no commissioner for bridge roads and relay posts; it is suspected that the office was not established or that the entry was omitted, and the same is true for Han Gaozu.) )
translations.idiomatic: (Xu Wudang's Commentary on the New History of the Five Dynasties notes: The veritable records in the Old History list no commissioner for bridge roads and relay posts; the office may never have been established or the entry may have been omitted—the same is true for Han Gaozu.) )

sentences.zh: 己卯，遣判四方館事朱崇節、右金吾大將軍梁言持國信物使於契丹。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, he dispatched Zhu Chongjie, who handled affairs of the Bureau for All Directions, and Right Golden Guard General-in-Chief Liang Yan as envoys bearing state gifts to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao he sent Zhu Chongjie, overseer of the Bureau for All Directions, and Right Golden Guard General-in-Chief Liang Yan as envoys bearing state gifts to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 是時，河南、河北、關西並奏蝗害稼。

translations.literal: At this time Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi all reported locusts damaging the crops.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi all reported locust damage to the crops.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸未朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the seventh month, autumn, the day guimwei, the hundred officials in plain dress attended mourning at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the seventh month, guimwei, the full bureaucracy in plain mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 戊子，詔應宮殿、州縣及官名、府號、人姓名，與先帝諱同音者改之。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, an edict ordered that wherever palace names, prefectures and counties, official titles, bureau names, or personal names shared the same sound as the late emperor's taboo name, they were to be changed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi an edict ordered that palace names, prefectures and counties, official titles, bureau names, and personal names that shared the sound of the late emperor's taboo name be changed.

sentences.zh: 改西京明堂殿為宣德殿，中書政事堂為政事廳，堂後官房頭為錄事，余為主事。

translations.literal: The Bright Hall of the Western Capital was renamed Hall of Proclaiming Virtue; the Secretariat's Hall of Government Affairs became the Government Affairs Office; the chief clerks in the rear offices of the hall were renamed recorders, and the rest were renamed section chiefs.
translations.idiomatic: The Bright Hall of the Western Capital was renamed Hall of Proclaiming Virtue; the Secretariat's Hall of Government Affairs became the Government Affairs Office; senior clerks in the rear offices were renamed recorders and the rest section chiefs.

sentences.zh: （《東都事略·陶穀傳》：穀本姓唐，避晉祖諱改姓陶，蓋當時避諱之體如此。）〉

translations.literal: (Eastern Capital Miscellany, Biography of Tao Gu: Gu's original surname was Tang; to avoid the taboo of the Jin founder he changed his surname to Tao—such was the form of taboo avoidance at the time.) )
translations.idiomatic: (Eastern Capital Miscellany, Biography of Tao Gu: Gu's original surname was Tang; to avoid the Jin founder's taboo he changed it to Tao—such was contemporary taboo practice.) )

sentences.zh: 己丑，大行皇帝大祥，帝釋缞服，百官衣縿。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the late emperor reached the day of great auspice; the Emperor removed his hemp mourning garments, and the hundred officials wore fine hemp.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the late emperor reached the day of great auspice; the emperor removed his coarse hemp mourning dress and the officials wore fine hemp.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，帝除禫服，百官吉服。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Emperor removed his final mourning garments, and the hundred officials wore auspicious dress.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor ended his final mourning garments and the officials wore formal dress.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，太皇太后劉氏崩，高祖之庶母也。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Grand Empress Dowager Lady Liu died; she was Gaozu's concubine mother.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Grand Empress Dowager Lady Liu died; she had been Gaozu's concubine mother.

sentences.zh: 遺詔服紀園陵毋用後禮，皇帝不得廢軍國機務。

translations.literal: Her testament ordered that mourning observances and the imperial tomb not use the rites of an empress, and that the emperor not suspend military and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Her testament ordered that mourning and her tomb not follow empress rites and that the emperor not suspend military and state business.

sentences.zh: 既而禮官奏：「準令式，為祖父母齊缞周；

translations.literal: Thereupon the ritual officials memorialized: "According to the statutes, for grandparents one wears unhemmed sackcloth for one year;
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials then memorialized: "According to the statutes, mourning for grandparents requires unhemmed sackcloth for one year;

sentences.zh: 又準喪葬令，皇帝本服周者，三哭而止。

translations.literal: and according to the burial ordinance, when the emperor's proper mourning is one year, he stops after three cries.
translations.idiomatic: and according to the burial ordinance, when the emperor's proper mourning period is one year, he stops after three cries.

sentences.zh: 請準後唐同光三年，皇太妃北京薨，莊宗於洛京西內發哀素服，不視事三日。

translations.literal: We request that it follow Later Tang in the third year of Tongguang, when the Imperial Consort Mother died at the Northern Capital and Emperor Zhuangzong mourned in plain dress in the western inner palace of Luoyang, not holding audience for three days.
translations.idiomatic: We ask that precedent be taken from Later Tang Tongguang 3, when the imperial consort mother died at the Northern Capital and Emperor Zhuangzong mourned in plain dress in Luoyang's western inner palace without holding audience for three days.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 仍遣國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏奏告高祖靈座。

translations.literal: He also dispatched Director of the Imperial Academy and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min to report at Gaozu's spirit seat.
translations.idiomatic: He also sent Director of the Imperial Academy and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min to report at Gaozu's spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，右諫議大夫鄭受益、中書舍人楊昭儉並停見任，以請假在外，不赴國喪故也。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Right Remonstrating Censor Zheng Shouyi and Secretariat Drafter Yang Zhaojian were both suspended from their current posts because, having taken leave and being away, they did not attend the state mourning.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Right Remonstrating Censor Zheng Shouyi and Secretariat Drafter Yang Zhaojian were both removed from active duty because they were away on leave and failed to attend the state mourning.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，宰臣馮道等率文武百僚詣崇德殿門拜表，請禦正殿，凡三上表，允之。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the chief ministers led by Feng Dao and the civil and military officials went to the Gate of Chongde Hall and submitted memorials requesting that he hold court in the main hall; they submitted three times, and he assented.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou chief ministers led by Feng Dao and the civil and military officials petitioned three times at Chongde Hall's gate that he hold court in the main hall, and he assented.

sentences.zh: 安州奏，水平地深七尺。

translations.literal: Anzhou reported that on level ground the water stood seven feet deep.
translations.idiomatic: Anzhou reported standing water seven feet deep on level ground.

sentences.zh: 庚子，帝御正殿，宣制：「大赦天下，諸道州府各色罪犯，除十惡五逆、殺人強盜、官典犯贓、合作毒藥、屠牛鑄錢外，其餘罪犯，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Emperor held court in the main hall and proclaimed: "A general amnesty is granted throughout the realm. For all manner of crimes in the various circuits, prefectures, and counties, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, murder, robbery, official corruption, compounding poison, slaughtering cattle, and counterfeiting coin, all other crimes are pardoned and remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the emperor held court in the main hall and proclaimed: "A general amnesty is granted throughout the realm. For crimes in every circuit, prefecture, and county, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, murder, robbery, official corruption, compounding poison, slaughtering cattle, and counterfeiting coin, all other offenses are pardoned.

sentences.zh: 襄州安從進如能果決輸誠，並從釋放。

translations.literal: If An Congjin of Xiangzhou can decisively submit his loyalty, he too shall be released.
translations.idiomatic: If An Congjin of Xiangzhou can decisively submit in loyalty, he too shall be released.

sentences.zh: 其中外臣僚將校，並與加恩。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials and commanders at court and in the provinces shall all receive added favor.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials and commanders at court and in the provinces shall all receive added favor.

sentences.zh: 天下有蟲蝗處，並與除放租稅。

translations.literal: Wherever locusts have appeared in the realm, rents and taxes shall be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever locusts have struck, rents and taxes shall be remitted.

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，恒州順國軍節度使杜威、河東節度使劉知遠，並加檢校太師，仍增爵邑。

translations.literal: " On the day xinchou, Shunguo Army Military Governor of Hengzhou Du Wei and Hedong Military Governor Liu Zhiyuan were both given the additional title of acting Grand Preceptor and their fiefs and ranks were increased.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinchou Shunguo Army military governor of Hengzhou Du Wei and Hedong military governor Liu Zhiyuan were both made acting Grand Preceptor and given increased fiefs and ranks.

sentences.zh: 青州平盧軍節度使楊光遠加守太師。

translations.literal: Pinglu Army Military Governor of Qingzhou Yang Guangyuan was given the honorary title of Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Pinglu Army military governor of Qingzhou Yang Guangyuan was given the honorary title of Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，鄆州天平軍節度使兼侍衛馬步都虞候景延廣加特進、同中書門下平章事，充侍衛親軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Tianping Army Military Governor of Yunzhou and Chief Inspector of the Palace Guard horse and foot Jing Yanguang was given the special advancement and made Co-Manager of Affairs under the Secretariat-Chancellery, and appointed Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard personal armies.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Tianping Army military governor of Yunzhou and chief inspector of the palace guard horse and foot Jing Yanguang was given special advancement and made Co-Manager of Affairs under the Secretariat-Chancellery and commander-in-chief of the palace guard personal armies.

sentences.zh: 滑州義成軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞，相州彰德軍節度使、侍衛步軍都指揮使郭謹，並加檢校太傅，仍增爵邑。

translations.literal: Yicheng Army Military Governor of Huazhou and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard horse Li Shouzhen, and Zhangde Army Military Governor of Xiangzhou and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard foot Guo Jin, were both given the additional title of acting Grand Tutor and their fiefs and ranks were increased.
translations.idiomatic: Yicheng Army military governor of Huazhou and commander of the palace guard horse Li Shouzhen, and Zhangde Army military governor of Xiangzhou and commander of the palace guard foot Guo Jin, were both made acting Grand Tutor with increased fiefs and ranks.

sentences.zh: 宰臣馮道等上表，請依舊置樞密使，略曰：「竊以樞密使創自前朝，置諸近侍，其來已久，所便尤多。

translations.literal: The chief ministers led by Feng Dao submitted a memorial requesting that the office of Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs be restored as before, stating in summary: "We venture to observe that the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs was created in the previous dynasty and placed among the close attendants; the office has long existed and has been especially convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Chief ministers led by Feng Dao memorialized to restore the office of Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs as before, stating in summary: "The commissioner was created in the previous dynasty and placed among close attendants; the office is long established and especially convenient.

sentences.zh: 頃歲樞密使劉處讓偶屬家艱，爰拘喪制，既從罷免，暫議改更，不曾顯降敕文，永停使額。

translations.literal: In recent years Commissioner Liu Churang happened to suffer a family bereavement and was bound by mourning regulations; once he was removed, a temporary change was discussed, but no explicit edict was ever issued permanently abolishing the commission.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years Commissioner Liu Churang happened to suffer a family bereavement and was bound by mourning rules; once he was removed, a temporary change was discussed, but no explicit edict ever permanently abolished the commission.

sentences.zh: 所願各歸職分，豈敢茍避繁難。

translations.literal: We wish each to return to his proper duties—how could we shirk difficulty out of mere convenience?
translations.idiomatic: We wish each to return to his proper duties and would not shirk difficulty for mere convenience.

sentences.zh: 伏請依舊置樞密使。

translations.literal: We humbly request that the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs be restored as before.
translations.idiomatic: We humbly request that the Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs be restored as before.

sentences.zh: 」初，高祖事後唐明宗，睹樞密使安重誨秉政擅權，賞罰由己，常惡之，及登極，故斷意廢罷，一委中書。

translations.literal: " Earlier, when Gaozu served Later Tang's Emperor Mingzong, he had seen Commissioner An Chonghui hold power and monopolize authority, with rewards and punishments at his own discretion, and he often hated this; when he ascended the throne he therefore resolved to abolish the office and entrust everything to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, while serving Later Tang's Emperor Mingzong, Gaozu had seen Commissioner An Chonghui monopolize power and control rewards and punishments himself, which he deeply resented; on ascending the throne he therefore resolved to abolish the office and entrust everything to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 至是馮道等厭其事繁，故復請置之，庶分其權。

translations.literal: At this time Feng Dao and the others wearied of the burden of affairs and therefore again requested its establishment, hoping to divide the power.
translations.idiomatic: Now Feng Dao and the others wearied of the burden of affairs and again requested its restoration, hoping to divide the power.

sentences.zh: 表凡三上，不允。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted three times; it was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted three times and was denied each time.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，徐州節度使李從溫、宋州節度使安彥威並加兼中書令，西都留守、充襄州行營都部署高行周加兼侍中，鳳翔節度使李從嚴加守太保。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Xuzhou Military Governor Li Congwen and Songzhou Military Governor An Yanwei were both given the additional title of Concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Western Capital regent and overall commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters Gao Xingzhou was given the additional title of Concurrent Palace Attendant; and Fengxiang Military Governor Li Congyan was given the honorary title of Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Xuzhou military governor Li Congwen and Songzhou military governor An Yanwei were both made concurrent Director of the Secretariat; Western Capital regent and overall commander of the Xiangzhou field army Gao Xingzhou was made concurrent Palace Attendant; and Fengxiang military governor Li Congyan was given the honorary title of Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 遣中使就中書賜宰臣馮道生辰器幣，道以幼屬亂離，早喪父母，不記生日，堅辭不受。

translations.literal: An imperial envoy was sent to the Secretariat to bestow birthday gifts and silks on Chief Minister Feng Dao; Dao, having been orphaned young amid turmoil and having lost his parents early, did not know his birthday and firmly declined to accept.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial envoy was sent to the Secretariat to bestow birthday gifts on chief minister Feng Dao; Dao, orphaned young amid turmoil and having lost his parents early, did not know his birthday and firmly declined.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以給事中羅周嶽為左散騎常侍，以右諫議大夫符蒙為給事中，以秘書少監兼廣晉少尹邊蔚為右散騎常侍，以廣晉少尹張煦為右諫議大夫，以廣晉府判官、光祿少卿邊光範為右諫議大夫。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, Supervising Censor Luo Zhouyue was made Left Regular Attendant; Right Remonstrating Censor Fu Meng was made Supervising Censor; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Concurrent Vice Prefect of Guangjin Bian Wei was made Right Regular Attendant; Vice Prefect of Guangjin Zhang Xu was made Right Remonstrating Censor; and Guangjin prefectural judge and Vice Director for Splendid Happiness Bian Guangfan was made Right Remonstrating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Supervising Censor Luo Zhouyue was made Left Regular Attendant; Right Remonstrating Censor Fu Meng, Supervising Censor; Vice Director of the Secretariat and concurrent vice prefect of Guangjin Bian Wei, Right Regular Attendant; vice prefect of Guangjin Zhang Xu, Right Remonstrating Censor; and Guangjin prefectural judge and Vice Director for Splendid Happiness Bian Guangfan, Right Remonstrating Censor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，荊南節度使、南平王高從誨加兼尚書令，湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加守太傅。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Jingnan Military Governor and King of Nanping Gao Conghui was given the additional title of Concurrent Director of the Department of State Affairs; Hunan Military Governor and King of Chu Ma Xifan was given the honorary title of Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Jingnan military governor and King of Nanping Gao Conghui was made concurrent Director of the Department of State Affairs, and Hunan military governor and King of Chu Ma Xifan was given the honorary title of Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 自是藩侯郡守，皆第加官封，示溥恩也。

translations.literal: From this time regional lords and prefects were all promoted in rank and enfeoffment in turn, showing broad favor.
translations.idiomatic: From this point regional lords and prefects were promoted in rank and enfeoffment in turn, displaying broad favor.

sentences.zh: 是月，州郡十七蝗。

translations.literal: That month, seventeen prefectures reported locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts were reported in seventeen prefectures.

sentences.zh: 八月壬子朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the eighth month, the day renzi, the hundred officials in plain dress attended mourning at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the eighth month, renzi, the full bureaucracy in plain mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左散騎常侍羅周嶽為東京副留守。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Left Regular Attendant Luo Zhouyue was made Deputy Regent of the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Left Regular Attendant Luo Zhouyue was made deputy regent of the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以山陵禮儀使、太常卿崔棁為太子賓客，分司西都，病故也。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Mausoleum Ritual Commissioner and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Rong was made Mentor of the Heir Apparent with duty at the Western Capital, having died of illness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen mausoleum ritual commissioner and Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Cui Rong was posthumously made Mentor of the Heir Apparent with duty at the Western Capital, having died of illness.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，晉昌軍節度使桑維翰加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, Jinchang Army Military Governor Sang Weihan was given the additional title of acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Jinchang Army military governor Sang Weihan was made acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，宰臣馮道加守太尉，趙瑩加中書令，李崧加左僕射兼門下侍郎，和凝加右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, Chief Minister Feng Dao was given the honorary title of Grand Commandant; Zhao Ying was made Director of the Secretariat; Li Song was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and Concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; and He Ning was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi chief minister Feng Dao was given the honorary title of Grand Commandant; Zhao Ying was made Director of the Secretariat; Li Song was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and concurrent Vice Director of the Chancellery; and He Ning was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使致慰禮馬二十匹及羅絹等物。

translations.literal: The Khitan sent envoys with condolence gifts of twenty horses and silks and other goods.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan sent envoys with condolence gifts of twenty horses, silks, and other goods.

sentences.zh: 是日，襄州行營都部署高行周奏，收復襄州，安從進自焚而死，生擒男宏贊斬之。

translations.literal: That day, Overall Commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters Gao Xingzhou reported that Xiangzhou had been recovered; An Congjin burned himself to death, and his son Hongzan was captured alive and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: That day overall commander of the Xiangzhou field army Gao Xingzhou reported the recovery of Xiangzhou; An Congjin burned himself to death, and his son Hongzan was captured alive and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 前河東節度使康福卒，贈太師，謚曰武安。

translations.literal: Former Hedong Military Governor Kang Fu died; he was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and the posthumous name Martial Tranquility.
translations.idiomatic: Former Hedong military governor Kang Fu died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor with the posthumous name Martial Tranquility.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以太子太保兼尚書左僕射劉句為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and Concurrent Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Liu Gou was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Liu Gou was made Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 詔賜襄州城內百姓粟，大戶二斛，小戶一斛，以久困重圍也。

translations.literal: An edict granted grain to the common people within Xiangzhou city—two hu to large households and one hu to small households—because they had long suffered under heavy siege.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted grain to the people within Xiangzhou city—two hu to large households and one hu to small—because they had long suffered under siege.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以太子賓客趙元輔權判太常卿事，充山陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Yuanfu was temporarily assigned to judge affairs of the Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and appointed mausoleum ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Mentor of the Heir Apparent Zhao Yuanfu was temporarily assigned to act as Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and appointed mausoleum ritual commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚午，葬太皇太后於魏縣秦固村。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Qinggu Village, Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the Grand Empress Dowager was buried at Qinggu Village in Wei County.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，契丹遣使致祭於高祖，賻禮御馬二匹、羊千口、絹千匹。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice for Gaozu, with funeral gifts of two imperial horses, a thousand sheep, and a thousand bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice for Gaozu, with funeral gifts of two imperial horses, a thousand sheep, and a thousand bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 契丹主母亦遣使來慰。

translations.literal: The Khitan emperor's mother also sent envoys with condolences.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan emperor's mother also sent envoys with condolences.

sentences.zh: 詔免襄州城內人戶今年夏秋來屋稅，其城外下營處與放二年租稅。

translations.literal: An edict remitted this year's summer and autumn dwelling taxes for households within Xiangzhou city, and for encampments outside the walls granted a two-year remission of rents and taxes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted this year's summer and autumn dwelling taxes for households within Xiangzhou and granted a two-year remission of rents and taxes for camps outside the walls.

sentences.zh: 應被安從進脅從者，一切不問。

translations.literal: All who had been coerced to follow An Congjin were not to be questioned.
translations.idiomatic: All who had been coerced into following An Congjin were exempt from prosecution.

sentences.zh: 是月，河中、河東、河西、徐、晉、商、汝等州蝗。

translations.literal: That month, Hezhong, Hedong, Hexi, Xu, Jin, Shang, Ru, and other prefectures reported locusts.
translations.idiomatic: That month locusts were reported in Hezhong, Hedong, Hexi, Xu, Jin, Shang, Ru, and other prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月丁丑朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, the day dingchou, the hundred officials in plain dress attended mourning at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, dingchou, the full bureaucracy in plain mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 己卯，分命朝臣詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, court officials were separately ordered to go to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao court officials were separately ordered to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，兩浙節度使吳越國王錢宏佐、福建節度使王延羲，並加食邑，仍改賜功臣名號。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Two-Zhe Military Governor and King of Wuyue Qian Hongzuo and Fujian Military Governor Wang Yanxi were both granted additional fief households and given new bestowed designations as meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Two-Zhe military governor and King of Wuyue Qian Hongzuo and Fujian military governor Wang Yanxi were both granted additional fief households and given new meritorious-service titles.

sentences.zh: 癸未，帝御乾明門，觀襄州行營都部署高行周、都監張從恩等獻俘馘。

translations.literal: On the day guimwei, the Emperor held court at Qianming Gate and watched Overall Commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters Gao Xingzhou, Chief Overseer Zhang Congen, and others present captives and severed heads.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei the emperor held court at Qianming Gate and watched overall commander of the Xiangzhou field army Gao Xingzhou, chief overseer Zhang Congen, and others present captives and severed heads.

sentences.zh: 有司宣露布訖，以安從進男宏受等四十四人徇於市，皆斬之。

translations.literal: When the relevant offices had proclaimed the victory bulletin, forty-four men including An Congjin's son Hongshou were paraded through the market and all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: After the relevant offices proclaimed the victory bulletin, forty-four men including An Congjin's son Hongshou were paraded through the market and beheaded.

sentences.zh: 曲赦京城禁囚。

translations.literal: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: A partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲申，宴班師將校於崇德殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, he feasted the commanders of the returning army at Chongde Hall and bestowed gifts in varying measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen he feasted the commanders of the returning army at Chongde Hall and bestowed gifts in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，宰臣和凝上《回河頌》，賜鞍馬器帛。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Chief Minister He Ning submitted an "Ode on the River's Return," and was granted a saddle horse, vessels, and silks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou chief minister He Ning submitted an "Ode on the River's Return" and was granted a saddle horse, vessels, and silks.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以宋州歸德軍節度使安彥威為西京留守兼河南尹；

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Guide Army Military Governor of Songzhou An Yanwei was made Western Capital regent and Concurrent Governor of Henan;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Guide Army military governor of Songzhou An Yanwei was made Western Capital regent and concurrent governor of Henan;

sentences.zh: 以襄州行營都部署、西京留守高行周為宋州節度使，加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Overall Commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters and Western Capital regent Gao Xingzhou was made Military Governor of Songzhou and given the additional title of acting Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: overall commander of the Xiangzhou field army and Western Capital regent Gao Xingzhou was made military governor of Songzhou and acting Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，降襄州為防禦使額，均、房二州割屬鄧州，升泌州為團練使額。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Xiangzhou was reduced to a defense command; Jun and Fang prefectures were detached to Dengzhou; and Bi prefecture was raised to a training command.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Xiangzhou was reduced to a defense command, Jun and Fang were transferred to Dengzhou, and Bi was raised to a training command.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以東京留守兼開封尹李德充為廣晉尹；

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Eastern Capital regent and Concurrent Prefect of Kaifeng Li Dechong was made Prefect of Guangjin;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Eastern Capital regent and concurrent prefect of Kaifeng Li Dechong was made prefect of Guangjin;

sentences.zh: 以宣徽南院使、襄州行營都監張從恩為東京留守兼開封尹，加檢校太尉；

translations.literal: Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and Chief Overseer of the Xiangzhou field headquarters Zhang Congen was made Eastern Capital regent and Concurrent Prefect of Kaifeng and given the additional title of acting Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and chief overseer of the Xiangzhou field army Zhang Congen was made Eastern Capital regent and concurrent prefect of Kaifeng and acting Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 以前同州節度使、襄州行營副部署宋彥筠為鄧州威勝軍節度使，加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: former Tongzhou Military Governor and Deputy Overall Commander of the Xiangzhou field headquarters Song Yanjun was made Weisheng Army Military Governor of Dengzhou and given the additional title of acting Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: former Tongzhou military governor and deputy overall commander of the Xiangzhou field army Song Yanjun was made Weisheng Army military governor of Dengzhou and acting Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 山陵禮儀使撰高祖祔饗太廟酌獻樂章，上之。

translations.literal: The mausoleum ritual commissioner drafted the libation hymn for Gaozu's enshrinement and offering in the imperial temple and submitted it.
translations.idiomatic: The mausoleum ritual commissioner drafted the libation hymn for Gaozu's enshrinement and offering in the imperial temple and submitted it.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，詔今後除授留守，宜降麻制。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, an edict ordered that hereafter, when appointing regents, hemp edicts should be issued.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin an edict ordered that future regent appointments should be proclaimed by hemp edict.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，樂平公主史氏進封魯國大長公主，壽安長公主烏氏進封衛國大長公主，鄭國長公主杜氏進封宋國大長公主。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Princess of Leping of the Shi clan was advanced to Grand Princess of Lu; Princess of Shou'an of the Wu clan was advanced to Grand Princess of Wei; and Princess of Zheng of the Du clan was advanced to Grand Princess of Song.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Princess of Leping of the Shi clan was advanced to Grand Princess of Lu, Princess of Shou'an of the Wu clan to Grand Princess of Wei, and Princess of Zheng of the Du clan to Grand Princess of Song.

sentences.zh: 荊南高從誨累表讓尚書令之命。

translations.literal: Gao Conghui of Jingnan repeatedly submitted memorials declining the appointment as Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Conghui of Jingnan repeatedly memorialized to decline the appointment as Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 己亥，追封故秦國長公主為梁國長公主，故永壽長公主為岐國大長公主，故延慶長公主為邠國大長公主。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the late Princess of Qin was posthumously advanced to Princess of Liang; the late Princess of Yongshou to Grand Princess of Qi; and the late Princess of Yanqing to Grand Princess of Bin.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the late Princess of Qin was posthumously advanced to Princess of Liang, the late Princess of Yongshou to Grand Princess of Qi, and the late Princess of Yanqing to Grand Princess of Bin.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以義成軍節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞充大行皇帝山陵一行都部署。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Yicheng Army Military Governor and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard horse Li Shouzhen was appointed overall commander of the late emperor's mausoleum procession.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yicheng Army military governor and commander of the palace guard horse Li Shouzhen was appointed overall commander of the late emperor's mausoleum procession.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以宣徽北院使、判三司劉遂清為鄭州防禦使，以澶州防禦使李承福為宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments Liu Suiqing was made Defense Commissioner of Zhengzhou, and Defense Commissioner of Caozhou Li Chenfu was made Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat and acting commissioner of the Three Departments Liu Suiqing was made defense commissioner of Zhengzhou, and defense commissioner of Caozhou Li Chenfu was made commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔大行皇帝十一月十日山陵，宜自十月一日至十一月二十日不坐，放文武百官朝參。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, an edict ordered that the late emperor's burial was set for the tenth day of the eleventh month; from the first day of the tenth month to the twentieth day of the eleventh month the throne was not to be occupied, and civil and military officials were excused from court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao an edict set the late emperor's burial for the tenth day of the eleventh month and ordered that from the first day of the tenth month through the twentieth day of the eleventh month the throne would not be occupied and civil and military officials were excused from court attendance.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上大行皇帝尊謚寶冊，百官素服班於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the late emperor's honorific title and jade register were presented; the hundred officials in plain dress took their places at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the late emperor's honorific title and jade register were presented, and the full bureaucracy in plain dress took their places at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：天福七年，中書門下奏：山陵禮儀使狀：「高祖尊謚號及廟號，伏準故事，將啟殯宮前，擇日命太尉率百僚奉謚冊，告天於圜丘畢，奉謚冊跪讀於靈前。

translations.literal: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: In the seventh year of Tianfu, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: The mausoleum ritual commissioner reported: "For Gaozu's honorific title and temple name, according to precedent, before opening the temporary palace, a day should be chosen and the Grand Commandant ordered to lead the hundred officials in presenting the title register, report to Heaven at the Round Mound, and then kneel and read the title register before the spirit.
translations.idiomatic: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: In Tianfu 7 the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: The mausoleum ritual commissioner reported: "For Gaozu's honorific title and temple name, according to precedent, before opening the temporary palace a day should be chosen and the Grand Commandant ordered to lead the hundred officials in presenting the title register, report to Heaven at the Round Mound, and then kneel and read the title register before the spirit.

sentences.zh: 」此累朝之制，蓋以天命尊極，不可稽留。

translations.literal: " This was the institution of successive dynasties, for the mandate of Heaven and supreme dignity could not be delayed.
translations.idiomatic: " This was the institution of successive dynasties, for the mandate of Heaven and supreme dignity could not be delayed.

sentences.zh: 今所上高祖聖文章武明德孝皇帝尊謚寶冊，伏緣去洛京地遠，寶冊難以往來，當司詳酌，伏請只差官往洛京，奏告南郊太廟。

translations.literal: The honorific title and jade register now presented for Gaozu, the Sagely Literary Martial Brightly Virtuous Filial Emperor, are submitted because Luoyang is far away and the jade register is difficult to transport back and forth; the responsible office has deliberated and humbly requests that officials be dispatched only to Luoyang to report at the Southern Suburb and the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: The honorific title and jade register now presented for Gaozu, the Sagely Literary Martial Brightly Virtuous Filial Emperor, are submitted because Luoyang is far away and the jade register is difficult to transport; the responsible office has deliberated and humbly requests that officials be dispatched only to Luoyang to report at the Southern Suburb and the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 其日，中書門下文武百官立班，中書令、侍中升靈座前讀寶冊，行告謚之禮。）〉

translations.literal: On that day the civil and military officials of the Secretariat-Chancellery would stand in formation; the Director of the Secretariat and the Palace Attendant would ascend before the spirit seat to read the jade register and perform the rite of proclaiming the posthumous title.) )
translations.idiomatic: On that day the civil and military officials of the Secretariat-Chancellery would stand in formation; the Director of the Secretariat and the Palace Attendant would ascend before the spirit seat to read the jade register and perform the rite of proclaiming the posthumous title.) )

sentences.zh: 禮儀使撰進高祖祔饗太廟酌獻樂章舞名，請以《咸和之舞》為名。

translations.literal: The ritual commissioner drafted and submitted the name of the libation hymn and dance for Gaozu's enshrinement and offering in the imperial temple, requesting that it be named the Dance of Universal Harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual commissioner drafted and submitted the name of the libation hymn and dance for Gaozu's enshrinement and offering in the imperial temple, requesting the name Dance of Universal Harmony.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥朔，百官素服臨於天清殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month, winter, the day xinhai, the hundred officials in plain dress attended mourning at Tianqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the tenth month, xinhai, the full bureaucracy in plain mourning dress attended at Tianqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 襄州利市廟封為順正王，仍令本州修崇廟宇。

translations.literal: The Lishi Temple of Xiangzhou was enfeoffed as King Shunzheng, and the prefecture was ordered to repair and honor the temple buildings.
translations.idiomatic: The Lishi Temple of Xiangzhou was enfeoffed as King Shunzheng, and the prefecture was ordered to repair and honor the temple buildings.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，啟攢宮，百官衣初喪服入臨。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the temporary palace was opened; the hundred officials in initial mourning dress entered to attend.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the temporary palace was opened and the officials in initial mourning dress entered to attend.

sentences.zh: 甲子，靈駕進發，帝於朱鳳門外行遣奠之祭，辭畢還宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the spirit carriage set out; the Emperor performed the farewell offering rite outside Zhufeng Gate and returned to the palace when the rites were complete.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the spirit carriage set out; the emperor performed the farewell offering rite outside Zhufeng Gate and returned to the palace when the rites were complete.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，太保盧質卒，贈太子太師，謚曰文忠。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, Grand Mentor Lu Zhi died; he was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent and the posthumous name Literary Loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Grand Mentor Lu Zhi died; he was posthumously made Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent with the posthumous name Literary Loyalty.

sentences.zh: 己卯，宰臣李崧母喪，歸葬深州，遣使吊祭之。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Chief Minister Li Song's mother died; he returned to Shenzhou for burial, and envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao chief minister Li Song's mother died; he returned to Shenzhou for burial, and envoys were dispatched to offer condolences and sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，契丹遣使致祭於高祖，賻馬三匹、衣三襲。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice for Gaozu, with funeral gifts of three horses and three suits of clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen the Khitan sent envoys to offer sacrifice for Gaozu, with funeral gifts of three horses and three suits of clothing.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅，葬高祖皇帝於顯陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day gengyin, Emperor Gaozu was buried at Xianling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengyin, Emperor Gaozu was buried at Xianling.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，湖南奏，前洪州節度使馬希振卒。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Hunan reported that former Hongzhou Military Governor Ma Xizhen had died.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Hunan reported that former Hongzhou military governor Ma Xizhen had died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔宰臣等分詣寺廟祈雪。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict ordered the chief ministers and others to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for snow.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict ordered the chief ministers and others to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for snow.

sentences.zh: 庚子，祔高祖神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Gaozu's spirit tablet was enshrined in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Gaozu's spirit tablet was enshrined in the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以金吾衛大將軍、權判三司董遇為三司使。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Golden Guard General-in-Chief and Acting Commissioner of the Three Departments Dong Yu was made Commissioner of the Three Departments.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Golden Guard General-in-Chief and acting commissioner of the Three Departments Dong Yu was made commissioner of the Three Departments.

sentences.zh: 詔：「州郡稅鹽，過稅斤七錢，住稅斤十錢，州府鹽院並省司差人勾當。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "Prefectures and districts shall tax salt: transit tax seven cash per jin, residence tax ten cash per jin; prefectural salt offices and provincial agencies shall dispatch men to oversee collection.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "Prefectures and districts shall tax salt: transit tax seven cash per jin, residence tax ten cash per jin; prefectural salt offices and provincial agencies shall dispatch men to oversee collection.

sentences.zh: 」先是，諸州府除蠶鹽外，每年海鹽界分約收鹽價錢一千七萬貫，高祖以所在禁法，抵犯者眾，遂開鹽禁，許通商，令州郡配征人戶食鹽錢，上戶千文，下戶二百，分為五等，時亦便之。

translations.literal: " Earlier, apart from silkworm salt, the various prefectures annually collected about seventeen million strings in salt prices from maritime salt boundaries. Because prohibitions everywhere produced many violators, Gaozu opened the salt ban and permitted free trade, ordering prefectures to levy a salt-money assessment on households—one thousand cash for upper households and two hundred for lower, divided into five grades—which was convenient at the time.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, apart from silkworm salt, the various prefectures annually collected about seventeen million strings in salt prices from maritime salt boundaries. Because prohibitions everywhere produced many violators, Gaozu opened the salt ban and permitted free trade, ordering prefectures to levy a salt-money assessment on households—one thousand cash for upper households and two hundred for lower, divided into five grades—which was convenient at the time.

sentences.zh: 至是掌賦者欲增財利，難於驟變前法，乃重其關市之征，蓋欲絕其興販歸利於官也。

translations.literal: At this time those in charge of revenue wished to increase profits but found it difficult to change the former law abruptly, so they increased market and pass duties, intending to cut off private trade and return profit to the state.
translations.idiomatic: At this time those in charge of revenue wished to increase profits but found it difficult to change the former law abruptly, so they increased market and pass duties, intending to cut off private trade and return profit to the state.

sentences.zh: 其後鹽禁如故，鹽錢亦征，至今為弊焉。

translations.literal: Thereafter the salt prohibition remained as before and the salt money was also levied—an abuse that continues to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter the salt prohibition remained as before and the salt money was also levied—an abuse that continues to this day.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「天地宗廟社稷及諸祠祭等，訪聞所司承管，多不精潔。

translations.literal: That day, an edict stated: "For Heaven and Earth, the imperial temples, the altars of soil and grain, and all other sacrifices, it has been learned that the offices in charge are often not meticulous or clean.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict stated: "For Heaven and Earth, the imperial temples, the altars of soil and grain, and all other sacrifices, it has been learned that the offices in charge are often not meticulous or clean.

sentences.zh: 宜令三司預支一年禮料物色，於太廟置庫收貯。

translations.literal: The Three Departments should advance one year's worth of ritual supplies and store them in a warehouse set up in the imperial temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Departments should advance one year's worth of ritual supplies and store them in a warehouse set up in the imperial temple.

sentences.zh: 差宗正丞主掌，委監察使監當，祭器祭服等未備者修制。

translations.literal: A vice director of the Court of the Imperial Clan should be assigned to manage it, with surveillance commissioners to oversee it, and ritual vessels and garments not yet prepared should be made or repaired.
translations.idiomatic: A vice director of the Court of the Imperial Clan should be assigned to manage it, with surveillance commissioners to oversee it, and ritual vessels and garments not yet prepared should be made or repaired.

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：敕差宗正丞石載仁專主掌，監察御史宋彥升監庫，兼差供奉官陳審璘往洛京，於太廟內隱便處修蓋庫屋五間，俟畢日，催促所支物色，監送入庫交付訖，取收領文狀歸閣。

translations.literal: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: An edict assigned Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan Shi Zairen to manage exclusively, Surveillance Censor Song Yansheng to oversee the warehouse, and also dispatched Palace Attendant Chen Shenlin to Luoyang to build five warehouse rooms in a convenient place within the imperial temple; when completed, he was to urge delivery of the allotted supplies, supervise their entry into the warehouse, take receipt documents, and return them to the archive.
translations.idiomatic: (Institutional History of the Five Dynasties: An edict assigned Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan Shi Zairen to manage exclusively, Surveillance Censor Song Yansheng to oversee the warehouse, and also dispatched Palace Attendant Chen Shenlin to Luoyang to build five warehouse rooms in a convenient place within the imperial temple; when completed, he was to urge delivery of the allotted supplies, supervise their entry into the warehouse, take receipt documents, and return them to the archive.

sentences.zh: 每有祠祭，諸司各請禮料。

translations.literal: Whenever there was a sacrifice, each office requested ritual supplies.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever there was a sacrifice, each office requested ritual supplies.

sentences.zh: 至時委監庫御史宋彥升、宗正丞石載仁旋行給付。

translations.literal: At the time, Warehouse Overseer Censor Song Yansheng and Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan Shi Zairen were entrusted to issue them on the spot.
translations.idiomatic: At the time, warehouse overseer Censor Song Yansheng and Vice Director of the Court of the Imperial Clan Shi Zairen were entrusted to issue them on the spot.

sentences.zh: 其大祠、中祠兼令監察御史檢點，小祠即令行事官檢點。

translations.literal: For major and middle sacrifices, surveillance censors were also ordered to inspect; for minor sacrifices, the officiating officers were to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: For major and middle sacrifices, surveillance censors were also ordered to inspect; for minor sacrifices, the officiating officers were to inspect.

sentences.zh: 如致慢易，本司準格科罪。

translations.literal: If negligence or disrespect occurred, the responsible office would punish according to the statutes.
translations.idiomatic: If negligence or disrespect occurred, the responsible office would punish according to the statutes.

sentences.zh: 其祭器未有者修制，已有者更仰整飭。）〉

translations.literal: Ritual vessels not yet possessed were to be made; those already possessed were to be put in proper order.) )
translations.idiomatic: Ritual vessels not yet possessed were to be made; those already possessed were to be put in proper order.) )

sentences.zh: 十二月辛酉，以威武軍節度副使、充福建管內諸軍都指揮使王亞澄為威武軍副大使，知節度事。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day xinyou, Weiwu Army Vice Military Governor and Commander-in-Chief of all armies within Fujian Wang Yacheng was made Vice Commissioner of the Weiwu Army and given charge of military governorship affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinyou, Weiwu Army vice military governor and commander-in-chief of all armies within Fujian Wang Yacheng was made vice commissioner of the Weiwu Army and given charge of military governorship affairs.

sentences.zh: 詔：「諸道州府，每遇大祭祀、冬至、寒食、立春、立夏、雨雪未晴，不得行極刑。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "In the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, whenever there are major sacrifices, the winter solstice, Cold Food Festival, Start of Spring, Start of Summer, or rain or snow not yet cleared, capital punishment shall not be carried out.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "In the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, whenever there are major sacrifices, the winter solstice, Cold Food Festival, Start of Spring, Start of Summer, or rain or snow not yet cleared, capital punishment shall not be carried out.

sentences.zh: 如有已斷下文案，可取次日及雨雪定後施行。

translations.literal: If a case has already been decided, execution may be taken up on the following day or after the rain or snow has cleared.
translations.idiomatic: If a case has already been decided, execution may be taken up on the following day or after the rain or snow has cleared.

sentences.zh: 」乙丑，以前鄧州節度使安審暉為左羽林統軍，以前延州節度使丁審琪為右羽林統軍，以前金州節度使潘環為左神武統軍，以前華州節度使皇甫立為左金吾衛上將軍，以右龍武統軍劉遂凝為左驍衛上將軍，以前貝州節度使馬萬為右驍衛上將軍，以左龍武大將軍張彥澤為右武衛上將軍。

translations.literal: " On the day yichou, former Dengzhou Military Governor An Shenhui was made Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army; former Yanzhou Military Governor Ding Shenqi, Commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army; former Jinzhou Military Governor Pan Huan, Commander of the Left Divine Martial Army; former Huazhou Military Governor Huangfu Li, General-in-Chief of the Left Golden Guard; Right Dragon Martial Commander Liu Suining, General-in-Chief of the Left Valiant Cavalry; former Beizhou Military Governor Ma Wan, General-in-Chief of the Right Valiant Cavalry; and Left Dragon Martial General-in-Chief Zhang Yanze, General-in-Chief of the Right Martial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: " On yichou former Dengzhou military governor An Shenhui was made commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army; former Yanzhou military governor Ding Shenqi, commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army; former Jinzhou military governor Pan Huan, commander of the Left Divine Martial Army; former Huazhou military governor Huangfu Li, general-in-chief of the Left Golden Guard; Right Dragon Martial commander Liu Suining, general-in-chief of the Left Valiant Cavalry; former Beizhou military governor Ma Wan, general-in-chief of the Right Valiant Cavalry; and Left Dragon Martial general-in-chief Zhang Yanze, general-in-chief of the Right Martial Guard.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，宰臣馮道、滑州節度使兼侍衛馬軍都指揮使李守貞、河陽節度使皇甫遇、西京留守安彥威、廣晉尹李德充，並加爵邑，以山陵充奉之勞也。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, Chief Minister Feng Dao, Huazhou Military Governor and Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard horse Li Shouzhen, Heyang Military Governor Huangfu Yu, Western Capital regent An Yanwei, and Prefect of Guangjin Li Dechong were all granted increased ranks and fiefs for their labor in supplying the mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin chief minister Feng Dao, Huazhou military governor and commander of the palace guard horse Li Shouzhen, Heyang military governor Huangfu Yu, Western Capital regent An Yanwei, and prefect of Guangjin Li Dechong were all granted increased ranks and fiefs for their labor in supplying the mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 己巳，回鶻進奉使密裏等各授懷化歸德大將軍、將軍郎將，放還蕃。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Uyghur tribute envoys including Mili were all granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and Returning to Virtue and general and captain, and were sent back to their lands.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Uyghur tribute envoys including Mili were all granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and Returning to Virtue and general and captain, and were sent back to their lands.

sentences.zh: 庚午，故洪州節度使馬希振追封齊國公。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the late Hongzhou Military Governor Ma Xizhen was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the late Hongzhou military governor Ma Xizhen was posthumously enfeoffed as Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，故中吳建武等軍節度使、彭城郡王錢元尞追封廣陵郡王。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the late Zhongwu and Jianwu Armies Military Governor and Prince of Pengcheng Commandery Qian Yuanliao was posthumously advanced to Prince of Guangling Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei the late Zhongwu and Jianwu armies military governor and Prince of Pengcheng Commandery Qian Yuanliao was posthumously advanced to Prince of Guangling Commandery.

sentences.zh: 丙子，于闐、回鶻皆遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, Khotan and the Uyghurs both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Khotan and the Uyghurs both sent envoys presenting local products.

sentences.zh: 天福八年春正月辛巳，盜發唐坤陵，莊宗母曹太后之陵也。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the eighth year of Tianfu, on the day xinsi, robbers opened Tang's Kunling—the tomb of Emperor Zhuangzong's mother, Empress Dowager Cao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in Tianfu 8, on xinsi, robbers opened Tang's Kunling—the tomb of Emperor Zhuangzong's mother, Empress Dowager Cao.

sentences.zh: 河南府上言：「逃戶凡五千三百八十七，餓死者兼之。

translations.literal: Henan prefecture reported: "Fugitive households number five thousand three hundred and eighty-seven in all, including those who died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: Henan prefecture reported: "Fugitive households number five thousand three hundred and eighty-seven in all, including those who died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 」詔：「諸道以廩粟賑饑民，民有積粟者，均分借便，以濟貧民。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered: "The various circuits shall use granary grain to relieve starving people; where people have stored grain, it shall be shared and lent out evenly to aid the poor.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered: "The various circuits shall use granary grain to relieve starving people; where people have stored grain, it shall be shared and lent out evenly to aid the poor.

sentences.zh: 」時州郡蝗旱，百姓流亡，餓死者千萬計。

translations.literal: " At this time prefectures suffered locusts and drought; the common people fled, and those who starved to death numbered in the tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: " At this time prefectures suffered locusts and drought; the common people fled, and those who starved to death numbered in the tens of millions.

sentences.zh: 東都人士僧道，請車駕復幸東京。

translations.literal: The gentry, monks, and Daoist priests of the Eastern Capital requested that the imperial carriage again visit the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: The gentry, monks, and Daoist priests of the Eastern Capital requested that the imperial carriage again visit the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 後唐莊宗德妃伊氏自契丹遣使貢馬。

translations.literal: Virtuous Consort Yi of Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong sent envoys from the Khitan to present horses.
translations.idiomatic: Virtuous Consort Yi of Later Tang's Emperor Zhuangzong sent envoys from the Khitan to present horses.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，沙州留後曹元深加檢校太傅，充沙州歸義軍節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Acting Commissioner of Shazhou Cao Yuanshen was given the additional title of acting Grand Tutor and appointed Military Governor of the Guiyi Army at Shazhou.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin acting commissioner of Shazhou Cao Yuanshen was made acting Grand Tutor and appointed military governor of the Guiyi Army at Shazhou.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，發禁軍萬人並家口赴東京。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, ten thousand men of the palace guard and their families were dispatched to the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi ten thousand men of the palace guard and their families were dispatched to the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，于闐、回鶻入朝使劉再成等並授懷化大將軍、將軍郎將，放還蕃。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Khotan and Uyghur envoys to court including Liu Zaicheng were all granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and general and captain, and were sent back to their lands.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Khotan and Uyghur envoys to court including Liu Zaicheng were all granted the titles of Great General of Cherishing Transformation and general and captain, and were sent back to their lands.

sentences.zh: 二月庚戌，御劄取今月十一日車駕還東京，沿路州府，不用修飾行宮；

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengxu, an imperial rescript set the eleventh day of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital; along the route prefectures were not to decorate palaces;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengxu, an imperial rescript set the eleventh day of this month for the imperial carriage to return to the Eastern Capital; along the route prefectures were not to decorate palaces;

sentences.zh: 食宿頓遞，並以官物供給；

translations.literal: food, lodging, and relay stations were all to be supplied from official stores;
translations.idiomatic: food, lodging, and relay stations were all to be supplied from official stores;

sentences.zh: 文武臣僚除有公事合隨駕外，並先次進發。

translations.literal: civil and military officials, except those with official business who should accompany the carriage, were all to set out in advance.
translations.idiomatic: civil and military officials, except those with official business who should accompany the carriage, were all to set out in advance.

sentences.zh: 以侍衛親軍使景延廣充御營使。

translations.literal: Commander of the Palace Guard personal armies Jing Yanguang was appointed Imperial Camp Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of the palace guard personal armies Jing Yanguang was appointed Imperial Camp Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以廣晉尹李德充權鄴都留守。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Prefect of Guangjin Li Dechong was made Acting Regent of the Ye capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou prefect of Guangjin Li Dechong was made acting regent of the Ye capital.

sentences.zh: 己未，車駕發鄴都，曲赦都下禁囚。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the imperial carriage set out from the Ye capital, and a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the imperial carriage set out from the Ye capital, and a partial amnesty was granted to prisoners in the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲子，次封丘，文武百官見於行宮。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the court halted at Fengqiu; the civil and military officials were received at the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the court halted at Fengqiu and the civil and military officials were received at the traveling palace.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，至東京。

translations.literal: On the day yichou, they arrived at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou they arrived at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以東京留守張從恩為權鄴都留守，以皇弟檢校司徒重睿為檢校太保、開封尹，年幼未出閣，差左散騎常侍邊蔚知府事。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Eastern Capital regent Zhang Congen was made Acting Regent of the Ye capital; the emperor's younger brother, Acting Minister of Education Chongrui, was made Acting Grand Mentor and Prefect of Kaifeng; being young and not yet leaving the women's quarters, Left Regular Attendant Bian Wei was assigned to manage prefectural affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Eastern Capital regent Zhang Congen was made acting regent of the Ye capital; the emperor's younger brother, acting Minister of Education Chongrui, was made acting Grand Mentor and prefect of Kaifeng; being young and not yet leaving the women's quarters, Left Regular Attendant Bian Wei was assigned to manage prefectural affairs.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前太僕卿薛仁謙為衛尉卿。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, former Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud Xue Renqian was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou former Director of the Court of the Imperial Stud Xue Renqian was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Guards.

sentences.zh: 河中逃戶凡七千七百五十九。

translations.literal: Fugitive households in Hezhong numbered seven thousand seven hundred and fifty-nine.
translations.idiomatic: Fugitive households in Hezhong numbered seven thousand seven hundred and fifty-nine.

sentences.zh: 是時天下饑，谷價翔踴，人多餓殍。

translations.literal: At this time the realm suffered famine; grain prices soared, and many died of starvation.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the realm suffered famine; grain prices soared, and many died of starvation.

sentences.zh: 右金吾衛上將軍劉處讓卒，贈太尉。

translations.literal: General-in-Chief of the Right Golden Guard Liu Churang died; he was posthumously given the title of Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: General-in-chief of the Right Golden Guard Liu Churang died; he was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 三月己卯朔，以中書令、監修國史趙瑩為晉昌軍節度使，以晉昌軍節度使桑維翰為侍中、監修國史。

translations.literal: On the first day of the third month, the day jimao, Director of the Secretariat and Supervisor of the National History Zhao Ying was made Jinchang Army Military Governor, and Jinchang Army Military Governor Sang Weihan was made Palace Attendant and Supervisor of the National History.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the third month, jimao, Director of the Secretariat and supervisor of the national history Zhao Ying was made Jinchang Army military governor, and Jinchang Army military governor Sang Weihan was made Palace Attendant and supervisor of the national history.

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》作晉昌節度使、兼侍中桑維翰為侍中。

translations.literal: (Comprehensive Mirror records: Jinchang Military Governor and Concurrent Palace Attendant Sang Weihan was made Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: (Comprehensive Mirror records: Jinchang military governor and concurrent Palace Attendant Sang Weihan was made Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 胡三省註云：桑維翰始居藩鎮而兼侍中，今入朝，正為門下省長官。）〉

translations.literal: Hu Sanxing's commentary states: Sang Weihan had first held a regional command while also serving as Palace Attendant; now entering court, he properly became chief of the Chancellery.) )
translations.idiomatic: Hu Sanxing's commentary states: Sang Weihan had first held a regional command while also serving as Palace Attendant; now entering court, he properly became chief of the Chancellery.) )

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以左散騎常侍盧重為秘書監，以東京副留守羅周嶽為右散騎常侍。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Left Regular Attendant Lu Chong was made Director of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital Deputy Regent Luo Zhouyue was made Right Regular Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Left Regular Attendant Lu Chong was made Director of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital deputy regent Luo Zhouyue was made Right Regular Attendant.

sentences.zh: 癸未，青州節度使、東平王楊光遠進封壽王，北京留守劉知遠、恒州節度使杜威並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day guimwei, Qingzhou Military Governor and Prince of Dongping Yang Guangyuan was advanced to Prince of Shou; Northern Capital regent Liu Zhiyuan and Hengzhou Military Governor Du Wei were both given the additional title of Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei Qingzhou military governor and Prince of Dongping Yang Guangyuan was advanced to Prince of Shou; Northern Capital regent Liu Zhiyuan and Hengzhou military governor Du Wei were both made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以鄜州節度使符彥卿為河陽節度使，以權鄴都留守、前開封尹張從恩為鄴都留守、廣晉尹，以右羽林統軍丁審琪為鄜州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Yanzhou Military Governor Fu Yanqing was made Heyang Military Governor; Acting Regent of the Ye capital and former Prefect of Kaifeng Zhang Congen was made Regent of the Ye capital and Prefect of Guangjin; and Commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army Ding Shenqi was made Yanzhou Military Governor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Yanzhou military governor Fu Yanqing was made Heyang military governor; acting regent of the Ye capital and former prefect of Kaifeng Zhang Congen was made regent of the Ye capital and prefect of Guangjin; and commander of the Right Forest of Feathers Army Ding Shenqi was made Yanzhou military governor.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，天策上將軍、湖南節度使、楚王馬希範加守尚書令、兼中書令。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Grand General of the Heavenly Stratagem, Hunan Military Governor, and King of Chu Ma Xifan was given the honorary title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and made Concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Grand General of the Heavenly Stratagem, Hunan military governor, and King of Chu Ma Xifan was given the honorary title of Director of the Department of State Affairs and made concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 己丑，桂州節度使馬希杲依前檢校太尉、兼侍中，兼知朗州軍州事；

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Guizhou Military Governor Ma Xigao retained his former additional titles of acting Grand Commandant and Concurrent Palace Attendant and was also given charge of Langzhou military and civil affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Guizhou military governor Ma Xigao retained his former additional titles of acting Grand Commandant and concurrent Palace Attendant and was also given charge of Langzhou military and civil affairs;

sentences.zh: 朗州武平軍節度使馬希萼加檢校太尉，進封爵邑。

translations.literal: Wuping Army Military Governor of Langzhou Ma Xi'e was given the additional title of acting Grand Commandant and advanced in enfeoffment and fief.
translations.idiomatic: Wuping Army military governor of Langzhou Ma Xi'e was made acting Grand Commandant and advanced in enfeoffment and fief.

sentences.zh: 以武平軍節度副使、岳州團練使馬希瞻為檢校太尉，領盧州昭信軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wuping Army Vice Military Governor and Luzhou Training Commissioner Ma Xizhan was made acting Grand Commandant and appointed Military Governor of the Zhaoxin Army at Luzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wuping Army vice military governor and Luzhou training commissioner Ma Xizhan was made acting Grand Commandant and appointed military governor of the Zhaoxin Army at Luzhou;

sentences.zh: 以武安軍節度副使、永州團練使馬希廣為檢校太尉，領洪州鎮南軍節度使；

translations.literal: Wu'an Army Vice Military Governor and Yongzhou Training Commissioner Ma Xiguang was made acting Grand Commandant and appointed Military Governor of the Zhennan Army at Hongzhou;
translations.idiomatic: Wu'an Army vice military governor and Yongzhou training commissioner Ma Xiguang was made acting Grand Commandant and appointed military governor of the Zhennan Army at Hongzhou;

sentences.zh: 皆楚王馬希範之弟也。

translations.literal: all were younger brothers of King of Chu Ma Xifan.
translations.idiomatic: all were younger brothers of King of Chu Ma Xifan.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以宣徽北院使李承福為右武衛大將軍，充宣徽南院使；

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat Li Chenfu was made General-in-Chief of the Right Martial Guard and appointed Commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat Li Chenfu was made general-in-chief of the Right Martial Guard and appointed commissioner of the Southern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat;

sentences.zh: 以前鄭州防禦使劉繼勛為左千牛衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使。

translations.literal: former Defense Commissioner of Zhengzhou Liu Jixun was made General-in-Chief of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and appointed Commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: former defense commissioner of Zhengzhou Liu Jixun was made general-in-chief of the Left Thousand-Ox Guard and appointed commissioner of the Northern Bureau of the Palace Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 國子祭酒兼戶部侍郎田敏以印本《五經》書上進，賜帛五十段。

translations.literal: Director of the Imperial Academy and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min presented printed copies of the Five Classics and was granted fifty bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Imperial Academy and Vice Minister of Revenue Tian Min presented printed copies of the Five Classics and was granted fifty bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 甲午，有白烏棲作坊桐樹，作坊使周務掠捕而進之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it.
