translations.idiomatic: On jiawu a white crow perched in a paulownia tree at the workshops; Workshop Commissioner Zhou Wu captured it and presented it.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，引進使、太府卿孟承誨使契丹。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, Commissioner of Tribute and Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Meng Chenghui was sent as envoy to the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Commissioner of Tribute and Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Meng Chenghui was sent as envoy to the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔京百司攝官親公事及五年，與授初官。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that acting officials in the capital bureaus who had handled personal official business for five years should be granted initial regular appointments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that acting officials in the capital bureaus who had handled personal official business for five years should be granted initial regular appointments.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左諫議大夫司徒詡為給事中，左司郎中王仁裕為右諫議大夫，前鴻臚卿王均為少府監。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Left Remonstrating Censor Situ Xu was made Supervising Censor; Left Bureau Director Wang Renyu was made Right Remonstrating Censor; and former Director of the Court of the Imperial Banquets Wang Jun was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Manufactories.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Left Remonstrating Censor Situ Xu was made Supervising Censor; Left Bureau Director Wang Renyu was made Right Remonstrating Censor; and former Director of the Court of the Imperial Banquets Wang Jun was made Director of the Court of the Imperial Manufactories.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month, summer, the day wushen, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the fourth month, wushen, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以許州節度使趙在禮為徐州節度使，以徐州節度使李從溫為許州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, Xuzhou Military Governor Zhao Zaili was made Military Governor of Xuzhou, and Xuzhou Military Governor Li Congwen was made Military Governor of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Xuzhou military governor Zhao Zaili was made military governor of Xuzhou, and Xuzhou military governor Li Congwen was made military governor of Xu.

sentences.zh: 己巳，中書門下奏：「請以六月二十七日降誕日為啟聖節。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month, the day of birth, be established as the Festival of Opening Sagacity.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the Secretariat-Chancellery memorialized: "We request that the twenty-seventh day of the sixth month, the day of birth, be established as the Festival of Opening Sagacity.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 是月，河南、河北、關西諸州旱蝗，分命使臣捕之。

translations.literal: That month, Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi prefectures suffered drought and locusts; envoys were separately dispatched to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: That month Henan, Hebei, and Guanxi prefectures suffered drought and locusts, and envoys were separately dispatched to capture them.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，追封皇故長姊為吳國長公主。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, the late emperor's elder sister was posthumously advanced to Grand Princess of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jimao, the late emperor's elder sister was posthumously advanced to Grand Princess of Wu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇侄女永福縣主薨，輟朝三日，追封平昌郡主。

translations.literal: On the day guimwei, the emperor's niece, District Mistress of Yongfu, died; court was suspended for three days, and she was posthumously advanced to Commandery Mistress of Pingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimwei the emperor's niece, District Mistress of Yongfu, died; court was suspended for three days, and she was posthumously advanced to Commandery Mistress of Pingchang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，皇第二叔祖贈太師萬友追封秦王；

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the emperor's second great-uncle, posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor Wan You, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qin;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the emperor's second great-uncle, posthumously made Grand Preceptor Wan You, was posthumously enfeoffed as Prince of Qin;

sentences.zh: 皇第三叔祖贈太尉萬銓贈太師，追封趙王。

translations.literal: the emperor's third great-uncle, posthumously given the title of Grand Commandant Wan Quan, was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's third great-uncle, posthumously made Grand Commandant Wan Quan, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 皇伯贈太傅敬儒贈太師，追封宋王；

translations.literal: the emperor's uncle, posthumously given the title of Grand Tutor Jingru, was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Song;
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's uncle, posthumously made Grand Tutor Jingru, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Song;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉福王德贈太師，追封如故；

translations.literal: the emperor's uncle, posthumously given the title of Grand Commandant, Prince of Fu Wang De, was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before;
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's uncle, posthumously made Grand Commandant Prince of Fu Wang De, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太傅暉贈太師，追封韓王；

translations.literal: the emperor's uncle, posthumously given the title of Grand Tutor Hui, was posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Han;
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's uncle, posthumously made Grand Tutor Hui, was posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as Prince of Han;

sentences.zh: 皇叔贈太尉通王殷、皇叔贈太尉廣王威、皇兄贈太傅郯王重裔並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: the emperor's uncles, posthumously given the title of Grand Commandant, Prince of Tong Wang Yin and Prince of Guang Wang Wei, and the emperor's elder brother, posthumously given the title of Grand Tutor, Prince of Tan Chongyi, were all posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's uncles, posthumously made Grand Commandant Prince of Tong Wang Yin and Prince of Guang Wang Wei, and the emperor's elder brother, posthumously made Grand Tutor Prince of Tan Chongyi, were all posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太師沂王重信追封楚王；

translations.literal: the emperor's elder brother, posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor, Prince of Yi Chongxin, was posthumously advanced to Prince of Chu;
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's elder brother, posthumously made Grand Preceptor Prince of Yi Chongxin, was posthumously advanced to Prince of Chu;

sentences.zh: 皇兄贈太傅虢王重乂、皇兄贈太師夔王重進、皇弟贈太尉陳王重杲等並贈太師，追封如故。

translations.literal: the emperor's elder brothers, posthumously given the title of Grand Tutor, Prince of Guo Chongyi, and posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor, Prince of Kui Chongjin, and the emperor's younger brother, posthumously given the title of Grand Commandant, Prince of Chen Chonggao, and others were all posthumously given the title of Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor's elder brothers, posthumously made Grand Tutor Prince of Guo Chongyi and Grand Preceptor Prince of Kui Chongjin, and the emperor's younger brother, posthumously made Grand Commandant Prince of Chen Chonggao, and others were all posthumously made Grand Preceptor and enfeoffed as before.

sentences.zh: 仍令所司擇日冊命。

translations.literal: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture edict.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices were further ordered to choose a day for the investiture edict.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以御史中丞王易簡為尚書左丞，以禮部侍郎張允為御史中丞，以中書舍人吳承範為禮部侍郎，以吏部侍郎王延為尚書右丞，以尚書右丞王松為吏部侍郎，以兵部侍郎張昭遠為吏部侍郎，以戶部侍郎呂琦為兵部侍郎，以刑部侍郎韋勛為戶部侍郎，以工部侍郎李詳為刑部侍郎。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun was made Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat Drafter Wu Chengfang was made Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan was made Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi was made Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Justice Wei Xun was made Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang was made Vice Minister of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Yijian was made Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Vice Minister of Rites Zhang Yun, Vice Censor-in-Chief; Secretariat drafter Wu Chengfang, Vice Minister of Rites; Vice Minister of Personnel Wang Yan, Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs; Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Song, Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of War Zhang Zhaoyuan, Vice Minister of Personnel; Vice Minister of Revenue Lü Qi, Vice Minister of War; Vice Minister of Justice Wei Xun, Vice Minister of Revenue; and Vice Minister of Works Li Xiang, Vice Minister of Justice.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，命宰臣等分詣寺觀禱雨。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the chief ministers and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the chief ministers and others were ordered to go separately to temples and monasteries to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 己亥，飛蝗自北翳天而南。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, flying locusts came from the north, darkening the sky as they moved south.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai flying locusts came from the north, darkening the sky as they moved south.

sentences.zh: 太子賓客李棁卒。

translations.literal: Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Rong died.
translations.idiomatic: Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Rong died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔：「諸道州府見禁罪人，除十惡五逆、行劫殺人、偽行印信、合造毒藥、官典犯贓各減一等外，餘並放。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, an edict stated: "For prisoners currently held in the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, highway robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official corruption, each of which shall be reduced one grade in punishment, all the rest shall be released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen an edict stated: "For prisoners currently held in the various circuits, prefectures, and districts, except the ten abominations, the five rebellions, highway robbery and murder, forging seals and credentials, compounding poison, and official corruption, each of which shall be reduced one grade in punishment, all the rest shall be released.

sentences.zh: 」是時所在旱蝗，故有是詔。

translations.literal: " At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere, and therefore this edict was issued.
translations.idiomatic: " At this time drought and locusts prevailed everywhere, and therefore this edict was issued.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸相國寺祈雨。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the emperor visited Xiangguo Temple to pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，以螟蝗為害，詔侍衛馬步軍都指揮使李守貞往臯門祭告，仍遣諸司使梁進超等七人分往開封府界捕之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day gengxu, because caterpillars and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Guard horse and foot Li Shouzhen to go to Gaomen to offer sacrifice and report, and also dispatched seven bureau commissioners including Liang Jinchao separately into the Kaifeng prefecture boundaries to capture them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengxu, because caterpillars and locusts were causing harm, an edict ordered commander-in-chief of the palace guard horse and foot Li Shouzhen to go to Gaomen to offer sacrifice and report, and also dispatched seven bureau commissioners including Liang Jinchao separately into the Kaifeng prefecture boundaries to capture them.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以左羽林統軍安審暉為潞州節度使。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, Commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army An Shenhui was made Military Governor of Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao commander of the Left Forest of Feathers Army An Shenhui was made military governor of Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 宿州奏，飛蝗抱草幹死。

translations.literal: Suzhou reported that flying locusts clung to the grass and died dry.
translations.idiomatic: Suzhou reported that flying locusts clung to the grass and died dry.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，貝州奏，逃戶凡三千七百。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, Beizhou reported fugitive households numbering three thousand seven hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Beizhou reported fugitive households numbering three thousand seven hundred.

sentences.zh: 遣供奉官衛延韜詣嵩山投龍祈雨。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant Wei Yantao was dispatched to Mount Song to cast a dragon petition and pray for rain.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant Wei Yantao was dispatched to Mount Song to cast a dragon petition and pray for rain.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以西京留守馬從斌為左監門衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Western Capital regent Ma Congbin was made General-in-Chief of the Left Gate Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Western Capital regent Ma Congbin was made general-in-chief of the Left Gate Guard.

sentences.zh: 開封府界飛蝗自死。

translations.literal: Within the Kaifeng prefecture boundaries, flying locusts died on their own.
translations.idiomatic: Within the Kaifeng prefecture boundaries, flying locusts died on their own.

sentences.zh: 庚申，河南府奏，飛蝗大下，遍滿山野，草苗木葉食之皆盡，人多餓死。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Henan prefecture reported that flying locusts descended in great numbers, filling the mountains and wilds; grass, trees, and leaves were all eaten clean, and many people starved to death.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Henan prefecture reported that flying locusts descended in great numbers, filling the mountains and wilds; grass, trees, and leaves were all eaten clean, and many people starved to death.

sentences.zh: 禮部侍郎吳承範卒。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Rites Wu Chengfang died.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Rites Wu Chengfang died.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以將冊皇太后，遣尚書左丞王易簡奏告天地。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, because the Empress Dowager was to be invested, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yijian was dispatched to report to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, because the Empress Dowager was to be invested, Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs Wang Yijian was dispatched to report to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 陜州奏，蝗飛入界，傷食五稼及竹木之葉，逃戶凡八千一百。

translations.literal: Shanzhou reported that locusts flew into its borders, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; fugitive households numbered eight thousand one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: Shanzhou reported that locusts flew into its borders, damaging the five grains and the leaves of bamboo and trees; fugitive households numbered eight thousand one hundred.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以給事中符蒙為禮部侍郎，以左諫議大夫裴坦為給事中。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Supervising Censor Fu Meng was made Vice Minister of Rites, and Left Remonstrating Censor Pei Tan was made Supervising Censor.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Supervising Censor Fu Meng was made Vice Minister of Rites, and Left Remonstrating Censor Pei Tan was made Supervising Censor.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣內外臣僚二十八人分往諸道州府率借粟麥。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, twenty-eight civil and military officials were dispatched separately to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to compel loans of grain and wheat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei twenty-eight civil and military officials were dispatched separately to the various circuits, prefectures, and districts to compel loans of grain and wheat.

sentences.zh: 時使臣希旨，立法甚峻。

translations.literal: At the time the envoys sought to please the court and established laws that were very harsh.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the envoys sought to please the court and established laws that were very harsh.

sentences.zh: 民間碓硙泥封之、隱其數者皆斃之，由是人不聊生，物情胥怨。

translations.literal: Among the people, mortars and mills were sealed with mud, and those who concealed their quantities were all put to death; thereby people could not sustain life, and sentiment everywhere turned to resentment.

sentences.zh: 是月，諸州郡大蝗，所至草木皆盡。

translations.literal: That month, great locust plagues struck the various prefectures and districts; wherever they went, grass and trees were consumed entirely.
